trailer.note: Trailer review table: the master (no co-play: no MCP on Android), uploaded to YouTube (unlisted or public, embeddable, monetisation off); Play takes one YouTube URL per listing. The Japanese and Arabic listings can take their own URLs of glob2-trailer-30s-ja-1080p.mp4 and -ar-1080p.mp4. Gate before the URL goes on the listing: read the Play Console ads and in-app purchase declarations (trailer review, store gates).

blocked: trailer preview-video: needs a hosted video URL (YouTube URL); upload glob2-trailer-30s-2160p.mp4 (linked at trailer/glob2-trailer-30s-2160p.mp4) there and enter the URL
unverified: Play's per-screenshot byte limit is not in the comparables record; 8 MB is the renderer's ceiling (verified by screenshots.py verify).
M9: which build Play users will install when these go live (closed test last recorded at 0.11.2.0; the frames show 0.11.8.0's touch interface).
